title: VaultDocument
description: read's codomain: a vault resource decoded by relating's markdown codec  -  a DOCUMENT, the codec specialization of a holography Resource {path, content}. It carries the subject the codec assigns, the frontmatter format, whether the frontmatter conforms (the codec's verdict), the decoded frontmatter record, the body, and the number of EAVT assertions the codec derived from it. This is the codec read of the vault, never raw bytes; the path is the codec witness. $id is the bare package-rooted descent path.

path.description: the vault-relative path of the resource (the codec witness)

subject.description: the subject the markdown codec assigns the document (its slug, else the witness)

format.description: the frontmatter format the codec recognized: "yaml", "toml", or null

conformant.description: whether the frontmatter conforms (the codec's frontmatter-conformance verdict)

frontmatter.description: the decoded frontmatter record (an arbitrary JSON object)

body.description: the decoded document body (frontmatter stripped by the codec)

assertions.description: the number of EAVT assertions the codec derived from the frontmatter + body
